clips.title: The story
paras: Near Starbreeze Village, you draw sacred water for Darnassus. Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar asks young night elves to replenish the city's moonwell, and the work teaches the history behind their care for Teldrassil's great boughs.

You carry a jade phial made by druids to Starbreeze Village, where a lesser moonwell holds sanctified water. Its refined craft lets you draw and carry the luminous water without disturbing its purity. Darnassus's central moonwell depends on these scattered fonts, and the elders send initiates on foot so the city's fountains stay full of Elune's grace. The journey also teaches the young what it takes to nourish Teldrassil.

Corithras Moonrage tells you of the sorrow that followed the Battle of Mount Hyjal. The sacrifice of Nordrassil, the ancestral World Tree, cost the night elves their immortality. Illidan Stormrage was unleashed amid the ruin, while Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage disappeared. Grief and isolation marked the days that followed, as the kaldorei turned to Teldrassil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: First, let me tell you more of the task you must complete. The druids in Darnassus use the water of the moonwells of Teldrassil, and their moonwell must be replenished from time to time. Using these specially crafted phials, you can collect the water of the moonwells.

Take this vessel to the moonwell outside of Starbreeze Village to the east, and fill it with some of its waters, then return to me. When you have completed your task, I shall continue the story where Tenaron left off...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello again, friend. Have you completed your task?

clips.title: Completion
paras: After the Battle of Mount Hyjal, we were without direction. Nordrassil smoked from the fire it unleashed, and our immortality--the very essence of our beings!--was lost.
It was in this trying time that the Betrayer was freed from his prison, and Shan'do Stormrage disappeared. A dark time for all.
